title: Fix coarse grid layout transitions and mip generation hazards
purpose: Resolve VUID 01197 and draw-time layout mismatches on coarse density image mips.

steps.detail: On creation, clear all mips and transition to SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL using a one-time command buffer. Record current layout per mip = SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL.

Per frame: Transition base mip 0 to GENERAL for compute splat; after compute, transition mip 0 to TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; generate mips via vkCmdBlitImage; transition all mips back to SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL. Do not attempt transitions inside dynamic rendering.
Track current layout per mip in CPU-side state; use that state as oldLayout in barriers. Avoid assuming a previous layout of GENERAL for higher mips.
Ensure image usage includes TRANSFER_SRC_BIT and TRANSFER_DST_BIT for blits, and SAMPLED_BIT for reads.
Log a compact state line per frame: 'Coarse mips: 0=SR O, 1=SRO, 2=SRO, ... → after update: 0=SRO, 1=SRO, ...'

acceptance: Coarse grid sampled correctly by shells/diagnostics
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('Synchronization2 image layout transitions with mip levels')
notes: If compute generates mips instead of blit, adjust accesses/stages to COMPUTE/SHADER_READ accordingly and still track per-mip layouts.
